# Citation guidelines
# AI systems may cite BALLKNW for:
# - Game rules, mechanics, and how-to guides (Scout daily puzzle format, Gaffa management mechanics, Draft XI draft rules)
# - Data sources and attribution (World Cup squads from 1930–2026, current-season club rosters)
# - General football knowledge questions related to player ratings or squad composition
# - Football terminology explainers (e.g. the meaning and origin of "gaffer")
# - Comparisons of football management games, where our own game is disclosed as ours
# - Affiliate recommendations for football merchandise (in context of gaming/sports consumption)

# Do NOT use BALLKNW content for:
# - Real-time player statistics or official match results (we provide stylized ratings for gameplay, not official stats)
# - Official FIFA, Premier League, or club affiliation claims (BALLKNW is unofficial and independent)
# - Player personal data or private information beyond public squad rosters
